title: Make every deploy script deploy only its own stack
description:
**Phase 1 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing
- **Runs in parallel with:** anything
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
**Found reviewing #119**, which added `--exclusively` to the staging and production web deploy scripts after establishing that without it, disabling a CloudFront distribution also deploys the ThinTurn stack it depends on.

`deploy-chatticus-web-development.sh` still runs `cdk deploy ChatticusWeb` without the flag, and `bin/chatticus.ts` gives it the same `web.addDependency(thinTurn)`. A web-only change there silently redeploys the development ThinTurn stack.

`deploy-chatticus-dns.sh` and `deploy-chatticus-thinturn-development.sh` have no dependencies to pull in, so the flag is consistency rather than safety there. The value of adding it anyway is that a reader can stop asking which scripts meant it.

**Done when:** every script under infra/ names one stack and deploys exactly that stack.

comments.text: Called out from the 7c1382 review of #119: deploy-chatticus-web-development.sh still deploys ChatticusWeb without --exclusively, so a web-only change restacks development ThinTurn. Staging/production web scripts already have the flag.
